title.zh: 伊尔库茨克疑似鼠疫事件

place.zh: 俄罗斯 · 伊尔库茨克州

briefing._doc: Editorial situation briefing. Update `updatedAt` whenever content changes; the UI shows it next to the briefing.

headline.zh: 检疫已解除，官方称 5500 余份检测均未发现危险病原体，但死因仍未公布。
headline.en: Quarantine lifted and 5,500+ tests found nothing dangerous, officials say, but the cause of death is still undisclosed.

known.zh: 1 人死亡（10 月 2 日），官方诊断为肺炎，未公布具体病原体。
known.en: One death (2 Oct); officially pneumonia, with no pathogen named.

known.zh: 官方称 5500 余份检测均未检出危险病原体，所有接触者已结束观察。
known.en: Officials say 5,500+ tests found no dangerous pathogens and all contacts have been released.

known.zh: 10 月 8 日州长宣布解除检疫。
known.en: The governor announced the quarantine was lifted on 8 Oct.

known.zh: 世卫组织评估风险：伊尔库茨克中低、俄罗斯低、欧洲极低。
known.en: WHO risk: moderate-to-low in Irkutsk, low for Russia, very low for Europe.

unknown.zh: 致死的病原体是什么？官方称不是鼠疫，但没有说明是什么。
unknown.en: Which pathogen caused the death? Officials say not plague but have not said what.

unknown.zh: 是否有第二名员工患病？俄方否认，但世卫组织的询问尚未得到公开答复。
unknown.en: Was a second employee ill? Russia denies it; WHO's question has not been publicly answered.

unknown.zh: 是否发生过实验室事故？媒体报道与两个官方委员会的结论相反。
unknown.en: Was there a lab accident? Media reports contradict two official commissions.

guidance.zh: 不要自行服用或囤积抗生素：没有预防作用，还会让真正需要的人买不到药。
guidance.en: Do not take or stockpile antibiotics on your own. It does not protect you and leaves less for people who need them.

guidance.zh: 肺鼠疫及早使用常见抗生素即可有效治疗。如出现高热、咳嗽、咳血或胸痛，请尽快就医，并告知医生近期行程。
guidance.en: Pneumonic plague is treatable with common antibiotics if started early. With high fever, cough, bloody sputum or chest pain, seek care promptly and mention recent travel.

guidance.zh: 以官方通报与世卫组织信息为准，警惕未注明来源的截图和转发。
guidance.en: Rely on official and WHO updates; be wary of unsourced screenshots and forwards.

dek.zh: 10 月 2 日，伊尔库茨克抗鼠疫研究所一名 28 岁员工死于重症肺炎。俄方称不是鼠疫，并否认出现第二例；世卫组织表示信息不足，仍在要求俄方说明。目前没有证据表明疫情在扩散。
dek.en: A 28-year-old employee of the Irkutsk Anti-Plague Institute died of severe pneumonia on 2 Oct. Russia says it was not plague and denies a second case; WHO says it lacks the information to judge and is still asking. There is no evidence of spread.

note.zh: 世卫组织 10 月 7 日表示，俄方提供的信息尚不足以完成全面风险评估。
note.en: On 7 Oct WHO said Russia had not yet shared enough information for a full risk assessment.

official.zh: 官方诊断为肺炎（“病因不明”或“社区获得性”），称样本中未检出鼠疫及其他与工作相关的病原体。
official.en: Pneumonia (“undetermined cause”, later “community-acquired”); no plague or work-related pathogen found in her samples.

independent.zh: 早期多家俄罗斯独立媒体报道为肺鼠疫，布里亚特领导人也曾说“可能是鼠疫”。世卫组织称死因仍无法解释。
independent.en: Early reports in several Russian independent outlets said pneumonic plague; Buryatia's leader said “maybe plague”. WHO says the death remains unexplained.

claim.zh: 疫情正在扩散 / 存在流行风险
claim.en: An outbreak is spreading / there is an epidemic risk

official.zh: 5500 余份检测均未发现危险病原体，所有接触者已结束观察，官方称不存在流行风险。
official.en: 5,500+ tests found no dangerous pathogens, all contacts released, and officials say there is no epidemic risk.

independent.zh: 目前没有任何来源报告出现新病例。世卫组织评估风险：伊尔库茨克中低，俄罗斯低，欧洲极低。
independent.en: No source reports new cases. WHO risk: moderate-to-low in Irkutsk, low for Russia, very low for Europe.

claim.zh: 出现第二例（第二名员工患病或死亡）
claim.en: There is a second case (another employee ill or dead)

official.zh: 俄消费者权益保护局称相关报道是“虚假信息”。

independent.zh: 说法仅见于部分俄语媒体和社交媒体，无法独立核实。世卫组织已就“第二名员工患肺炎”提出询问，尚未获公开答复。
independent.en: Only in some Russian-language outlets and social media; not independently verifiable. WHO asked about a second employee with pneumonia and has had no public answer.

claim.zh: 她在实验室打碎了装有鼠疫菌的试管
claim.en: She broke a test tube containing plague bacteria

official.zh: 两个生物安全委员会均称研究所未发生事故，并称她接种过疫苗、具有免疫力。
official.en: Two biosafety commissions found no accident; officials say she was vaccinated and immune.

independent.zh: 《贝加尔人》、雨电视台、The Insider 援引知情人士报道了 9 月 25 日的试管事故。
independent.en: Lyudi Baikala, TV Rain and The Insider reported a 25 Sept test-tube accident, citing insiders.

official.zh: 官方称所有已识别的接触者均接受医学观察，未公布具体人数；10 月 8 日宣布全部结束观察。
official.en: Officials said all identified contacts were observed, without a number; on 8 Oct all were released.

independent.zh: 多家媒体报道约 197 人，其中 100 余人住院观察；另有报道称研究所 60 余名员工被限制在所内。
independent.en: Several outlets reported ~197, over 100 in hospital wards; another report said 60+ institute staff were confined on site.

claim.zh: 伊尔库茨克多家医院被关闭

official.zh: 官方称“大规模关闭医院”是虚假信息；10 月 8 日宣布解除检疫。
official.en: Officials called “mass hospital closures” fake; quarantine lifted on 8 Oct.

independent.zh: 舍列霍夫区医院部分科室暂停收治有多方来源支持；另有媒体报道数家市内医院限制探视和收治。限制属实，但“全面关闭”的说法夸大了。
independent.en: Well sourced: some wards at Shelekhov District Hospital stopped admissions. Media also reported visiting and admission limits at several city hospitals. Restrictions, yes; “shut down”, overstated.

claim.zh: 药店抗生素被抢购一空

independent.zh: 多家媒体报道，10 月 3 日至 6 日伊尔库茨克和舍列霍夫部分药店售罄或只接受预订。本站自 10 月 7 日起监测连锁药房库存，尚未发现异常。
independent.en: Several outlets reported sell-outs or pre-order-only at some Irkutsk and Shelekhov pharmacies on 3–6 Oct. Our pharmacy monitoring since 7 Oct has not shown an anomaly.

claim.zh: 美国因鼠疫要求公民撤离俄罗斯
claim.en: The US told citizens to leave Russia because of plague

official.zh: 美国使馆 10 月 6 日发布的是健康警报。“立即离开俄罗斯”出自早已生效的四级旅行警告，原因是错误拘押风险等安全问题，与鼠疫无关。美国疾控中心称风险“极低”。
official.en: The 6 Oct embassy notice was a health alert. “Depart immediately” comes from the long-standing Level 4 advisory, issued over wrongful detention and security risks, not plague. The CDC calls the risk “extremely low”.

independent.zh: 多篇报道把警报标题写成“因鼠疫撤侨”。
independent.en: Several reports headlined the alert as an evacuation over plague.

claim.en: This is linked to a bioweapon

official.zh: 俄方否认存在事故。美国总统特朗普说“我们不认为”这是生物武器。
official.en: Russia denies any accident. US President Trump said “we don't think” it is a bioweapon.

independent.zh: 这类说法仅见于评论文章和社交媒体，没有证据支持。
independent.en: Only in commentary and on social media; no evidence offered.

definition.zh: 经官方实验室检测确认的鼠疫病例。俄罗斯当局称未检出鼠疫病原体。
definition.en: Plague cases confirmed by official laboratory testing. Russian authorities say no plague pathogen has been detected.

note.zh: 俄方向世卫组织通报：伊尔库茨克州未登记鼠疫病例
note.en: Russia told WHO no plague case is registered in Irkutsk oblast

note.zh: 俄方向世卫组织通报：伊尔库茨克州未登记鼠疫病例
note.en: Russia told WHO no plague case is registered in Irkutsk oblast

definition.zh: 公开提及可能为鼠疫、但未经实验室确认的病例，包括目前唯一的死者。“第二名员工患病”属未证实报道，单独列出。
definition.en: Cases publicly linked to possible plague but not lab-confirmed, including the one death so far. The reported second ill employee is unverified and shown separately.

note.zh: 第二例的说法已被官方否认，世卫组织仍在询问
note.en: Second case officially denied; WHO question still open

note.zh: 第二例的说法已被官方否认，世卫组织仍在询问
note.en: Second case officially denied; WHO question still open

definition.zh: 官方确认的死亡人数，死因未必是鼠疫。官方死因为“病因不明的肺炎”。
definition.en: Officially confirmed deaths, whatever the cause. The official cause is “pneumonia of undetermined etiology”.

note.zh: 第二例死亡的说法已被官方否认
note.en: Claimed second death officially denied

note.zh: 第二例死亡的说法已被官方否认
note.en: Claimed second death officially denied

definition.zh: 仍在接受医学观察或隔离的接触者人数。高峰时媒体报道约 197 人；官方 10 月 8 日称所有接触者已结束观察。
definition.en: Contacts still under medical observation or isolation. Media reported about 197 at the peak; officials said on 8 Oct all contacts had been released.

note.zh: 所有接触者已结束观察
note.en: All contacts released

note.zh: 所有接触者已结束观察
note.en: All contacts released

definition.zh: 官方公布的累计实验室检测数量及结果。
definition.en: Cumulative laboratory tests and results reported by officials.

note.zh: 多种方法检测，均未检出危险病原体
note.en: Several methods; no dangerous pathogens

note.zh: 全部未检出危险病原体
note.en: No dangerous pathogens detected

note.zh: 多种方法检测，均未检出危险病原体
note.en: Several methods; no dangerous pathogens

definition.zh: 据报道实施检疫或接诊限制的医疗机构数量。官方否认“大规模关闭医院”。
definition.en: Medical facilities reported to have quarantine or admission restrictions. Officials deny “mass hospital closures”.

note.zh: 州长宣布解除检疫（未点名具体机构）
note.en: Governor says quarantine lifted (facilities not named)

note.zh: 州长宣布解除检疫（未点名具体机构）
note.en: Governor says quarantine lifted (facilities not named)

title.zh: 特朗普：“我们不认为”这是生物武器
title.en: Trump: “we don't think” it is a bioweapon

summary.zh: 此前网上有生物武器的猜测，美国总统特朗普对此予以否定。
summary.en: The US president dismissed online speculation about a bioweapon.

title.zh: 美国对来自伊尔库茨克地区的旅客进行健康评估；疾控中心称风险“极低”
title.en: US to assess travellers from the Irkutsk area; CDC calls the risk “extremely low”

summary.zh: 相关旅客须经指定机场入境，并接受行程和接触史问询及基本健康检查。美国未发布禁止登机令，也未限制所有来自俄罗斯的旅客。美方称每年从伊尔库茨克州赴美的旅客约 200 人。
summary.en: Arrivals must use designated airports and get questions on travel and contacts plus a basic health check. No do-not-board orders and no general restriction on travellers from Russia. About 200 people a year fly to the US from Irkutsk Oblast.

title.zh: 伊尔库茨克州州长宣布解除检疫
title.en: Irkutsk governor announces the quarantine has been lifted

summary.zh: 州长科布泽夫在 Telegram 发文宣布解除检疫，并称死者接种过疫苗、安全管控“得到确认”。他没有说明具体是哪些机构解除了检疫。
summary.en: Governor Igor Kobzev said on Telegram the quarantine was lifted and that the deceased was vaccinated and safety controls were “confirmed”. He did not name which facilities.

title.zh: 官方宣布调查结束：5500 余份检测未发现危险病原体，所有接触者结束医学观察
title.en: Officials say checks are complete: 5,500+ tests found no dangerous pathogens; all contacts released

summary.zh: 俄消费者权益保护局称已用多种方法完成 5500 余份实验室检测（当天早些时候的说法是近 5000 份），两个生物安全委员会均未发现事故。官方仍未公布具体病原体。
summary.en: Rospotrebnadzor said more than 5,500 lab tests by several methods found nothing dangerous (earlier the same day it said nearly 5,000), and two biosafety commissions found no accident. No pathogen has been named.

title.zh: 俄消费者权益保护局否认出现第二例感染，称相关报道为“虚假信息”
title.en: Rospotrebnadzor denies a second infection, calls reports “fake information”

summary.zh: 官方否认这一事实已确认；但世卫组织就“第二名员工患肺炎”提出的询问尚未得到公开答复，因此本站将该说法标为“存在争议”。
summary.en: The denial itself is confirmed. WHO's question about a second employee with pneumonia has not been publicly answered, so we label the claim “disputed”.

title.zh: 据报道欧盟将紧急讨论此事
title.en: EU reportedly to hold urgent discussion

summary.zh: 《The Insider》报道欧盟计划紧急讨论此事。欧盟机构尚未发表正式声明。
summary.en: The Insider reported the EU planned an urgent discussion. No formal statement from EU bodies yet.

title.zh: 俄消费者权益保护局：无流行风险；约 5000 份检测均未检出危险病原体
title.en: Rospotrebnadzor: “no epidemic risk”; ~5,000 lab tests found no dangerous pathogens

summary.zh: 该机构称：约 5000 份实验室检测未发现危险病原体，九成以上接触者已结束医学观察，死者接种过疫苗、对其接触的病原体具有免疫力。佩斯科夫将相关媒体报道称为“虚假信息”。
summary.en: The agency said ~5,000 lab tests found no dangerous pathogens, more than 90% of contacts have completed medical observation, and the deceased was vaccinated against the pathogens she handled. Peskov called media reports “false information”.

title.zh: 美国国务院正式要求俄方提供更多信息
title.en: US State Department formally requests more information from Russia

summary.zh: 美国国务院证实已正式向俄罗斯政府索取更多信息。特朗普表示预计将与普京通话，克里姆林宫称目前没有安排通话。
summary.en: State confirmed it formally requested additional information from the Russian government. Trump said he expects to speak with Putin; the Kremlin said no call is scheduled.

title.zh: 世卫组织要求俄方说明死因、病原体，以及“第二名员工患肺炎”的报道
title.en: WHO asks Russia to clarify the cause, the pathogen and reports of a second employee with pneumonia

summary.zh: 世卫组织总干事呼吁及时、完整、透明地共享信息。世卫组织提出询问这一事实已确认；“第二名员工患病”本身仍属未证实的媒体报道。
summary.en: The WHO Director-General called for timely, complete and transparent information-sharing. That WHO asked is confirmed; the second illness itself remains an unverified media report.

title.zh: 美国驻莫斯科大使馆发布健康警报
title.en: U.S. Embassy Moscow issues a Health Alert

summary.zh: 警报提及有关疑似肺鼠疫的媒体报道以及伊尔库茨克医院的检疫措施，建议遵循当地卫生部门指导、避开受影响设施，出现发热或呼吸道症状时及时就医。“请勿前往”的四级旅行警告原本就已生效。
summary.en: The alert cites press reports of suspected pneumonic plague and hospital quarantines in Irkutsk, and advises following local health guidance, avoiding affected facilities and seeking care for fever or respiratory symptoms. The Level 4 “Do Not Travel” advisory was already in place.

title.zh: 部分俄媒称出现第二例死亡，未经证实
title.en: Some Russian outlets report a second death — unverified

summary.zh: 部分俄罗斯媒体称出现第二例死亡。俄消费者权益保护局 10 月 8 日称相关说法为“虚假信息”，目前没有任何独立证据支持。本站不将其计入死亡人数。
summary.en: Some Russian outlets claimed a second death. Rospotrebnadzor called such reports “fake information” on 8 Oct, and there is no independent evidence for it. Not counted in the death toll.

title.zh: 世卫组织：俄方通报伊尔库茨克州未登记鼠疫病例；风险评估为中低
title.en: WHO: Russia reports no plague case registered in Irkutsk; risk moderate-to-low

summary.zh: 世卫组织将风险评估为：伊尔库茨克中低，俄罗斯全国低，世卫组织欧洲区域极低。所有接触者均已识别并接受监测，未出现症状，均未检出危险传染病病原体。官方死因尚未确认。
summary.en: WHO assessed risk as moderate-to-low for Irkutsk, low for Russia and very low for the WHO European Region. All contacts were identified and monitored, none symptomatic, and no dangerous pathogens were detected in any of them. The cause of death is not yet confirmed.

title.zh: 哈萨克斯坦、吉尔吉斯斯坦、乌兹别克斯坦加强边境卫生检查
title.en: Kazakhstan, Kyrgyzstan and Uzbekistan tighten border sanitary checks

summary.zh: 中亚国家宣布对入境人员加强卫生检疫，属于预防性措施。
summary.en: Central Asian states announced stronger sanitary screening of arrivals as a precaution.

title.zh: 伊尔库茨克一家妇产医院对就诊者进行鼠疫筛查
title.en: Irkutsk maternity hospital screens patients for plague

summary.zh: 当地博主称院方向就诊者发放“疑似鼠疫检查清单”。这是预防性筛查，不代表出现病例。
summary.en: A local blogger said staff handed out a “checklist for suspected plague”. A precautionary screen, not evidence of cases.

title.zh: 美国国务卿卢比奥：正密切关注；特朗普表示美方将提供帮助
title.en: US Secretary of State Rubio: “closely monitoring”; Trump says the US will help

summary.zh: 美国疾控中心与国务院正在跟踪事态，美国国务院呼吁俄方“迅速、公开地分享准确信息”。
summary.en: CDC and the State Department are tracking the situation; State urged Russian authorities to “share accurate information quickly and openly”.

title.zh: 接触者中检出新冠和鼻病毒，未检出危险病原体
title.en: Contacts test positive for COVID-19 and rhinovirus, not dangerous pathogens

summary.zh: 据报道，部分接触者检出普通呼吸道病毒（新冠、鼻病毒），未检出鼠疫等危险传染病病原体。
summary.en: Some contacts reportedly tested positive for common respiratory viruses (COVID-19, rhinovirus); no dangerous pathogens such as plague were detected.

title.zh: 官方委员会：研究所未发生病原体操作事故；克里姆林宫呼吁只相信官方信息
title.en: Commission finds no accident at the institute; Kremlin urges trust in official sources

summary.zh: 俄消费者权益保护局委员会称，未发现研究所在操作病原体时发生事故。克里姆林宫发言人佩斯科夫呼吁民众只相信官方信息。
summary.en: Rospotrebnadzor's commission said it found no accident involving pathogens at the institute. Kremlin spokesman Dmitry Peskov told citizens to trust only official sources.

title.zh: 俄消费者权益保护局：病因不明的肺炎，未检出与工作相关的微生物
title.en: Rospotrebnadzor: pneumonia of undetermined etiology; no work-related microorganisms found

summary.zh: 联邦卫生监管机构表示，死者生物样本中未检出与其职业活动相关的微生物，伊尔库茨克州的卫生流行病学形势稳定。
summary.en: The federal health watchdog said no microorganisms related to her professional activity were found in her biological material, and that the sanitary-epidemiological situation in the region is stable.

title.zh: 伊尔库茨克与舍列霍夫出现抗生素抢购，部分药店售罄
title.en: Antibiotic panic-buying in Irkutsk and Shelekhov; some pharmacies sold out

summary.zh: 据报道，周末居民在药店抢购抗生素和口罩，部分药店售罄或只接受预订。自行服用抗生素没有预防作用，还可能耽误真正的治疗。
summary.en: Residents reportedly stocked up on antibiotics and masks over the weekend; some pharmacies sold out or switched to pre-orders. Self-medicating with antibiotics does not protect you and can delay proper treatment.

title.zh: 伊尔库茨克多家医院实施限制措施
title.en: Restrictions reported at several Irkutsk hospitals

summary.en: Media reported quarantine restrictions at City Clinical Hospitals No. 1, 3 and 10 and the Ivano-Matreninskaya children's hospital, and a mask rule at the IrkAZ aluminium plant. Officials called social-media claims of mass hospital closures fake.

summary.en: Russia's chief state sanitary doctor reportedly arrived in Irkutsk the same day; quarantine measures followed.

summary.en: Governor Igor Kobzev said all identified contacts were under medical observation with negative tests (official). The figure of ~197 comes from media reports.

title.zh: 布里亚特共和国领导人称死者“可能死于鼠疫”
title.en: Buryatia's leader says the woman “died, maybe of the plague”

summary.zh: 邻近的布里亚特共和国领导人齐坚诺夫公开提及鼠疫。他不是卫生主管部门，联邦卫生部门随后未确认这一说法。这是“疑似”标签的主要依据之一。
summary.en: Alexei Tsydenov, head of neighbouring Buryatia, publicly mentioned plague. He is not a health authority and federal health officials have not confirmed it. This is one of the main bases for the “suspected” label.

title.zh: 患者死亡；官方死因为“病因不明的肺炎”
title.en: Patient dies; official cause: “pneumonia of undetermined etiology”

summary.zh: 10 月 1 日至 2 日夜间，这名 28 岁实验员在舍列霍夫区医院死亡。死亡本身经官方确认；俄消费者权益保护局将死因定为病因不明的肺炎，并称未在其样本中检出鼠疫病原体。
summary.en: The 28-year-old technician died at Shelekhov District Hospital overnight on 1–2 Oct. The death is officially confirmed; Rospotrebnadzor records the cause as pneumonia of undetermined etiology and says no plague pathogen was found in her samples.

title.zh: 舍列霍夫医院多个科室暂停收治与出院
title.en: Shelekhov hospital halts admissions and discharges in several wards

summary.zh: 地方媒体 Borus 报道，自 10 月 1 日起，舍列霍夫区医院多个科室暂停接收和出院。早期报道称约 90 人接受观察。
summary.en: Local outlet Borus reported admissions and discharges were suspended in several departments from 1 Oct. Early reports put about 90 people under observation.

title.zh: 患者因重症肺炎入住舍列霍夫区医院
title.en: Patient hospitalised with severe pneumonia in Shelekhov

summary.zh: 伊尔库茨克抗鼠疫研究所一名员工因重症肺炎被送往舍列霍夫区医院并使用呼吸机。官方确认住院及肺炎诊断；病原体未获官方确认。
summary.en: An employee of the Irkutsk Anti-Plague Institute was taken to Shelekhov District Hospital with severe pneumonia and put on a ventilator. Hospitalisation and pneumonia are officially acknowledged; the pathogen is not.

title.zh: 媒体称：实验员处理鼠疫菌时打碎试管
title.en: Media: technician reportedly broke a test tube containing Y. pestis

summary.zh: 多家俄罗斯独立媒体援引《贝加尔人》称，这名 28 岁实验员在 9 月 25 日采样时打碎装有鼠疫耶尔森菌的试管。俄消费者权益保护局委员会 10 月 5 日称未发现事故，因此该说法目前存在争议。
summary.en: Russian independent outlets, citing Lyudi Baikala, reported the 28-year-old technician broke a tube containing Yersinia pestis on 25 Sept. Rospotrebnadzor's commission said on 5 Oct it found no accident, so the claim is disputed.
